data.name: Wonderchar
data.description: Wonderchar Inc. is a Texas-based biochar producer that converts waste pecan shells (and some softwood) into OMRI-certified biochar products for soil amendment, compost, turf and fertilizer blending. Products are offered in bulk bags and paper sacks under the PecanChar and WoodChar brands, with pyrolysis-based carbon sequestration as a core value proposition.
